empty.periodsText: Create the first period to calculate pay from each employee's basic salary.

generate.title: Create payroll period
generate.description: Creates a draft for every current employee hired by the end of the month, at their current basic salary. Safe to run again: people who already have a row are skipped (useful for new hires).

detail.caption: Payroll for {period}
detail.manualDeductions: Add deductions (such as absences or unpaid leave) yourself in each person's details.

submit.title: Submit payroll for {period}?
submit.description: All drafts in this period ({count} people) are locked and sent for approval.

return.title: Return {period} to draft?
return.description: HR can edit it again and resubmit.

approve.title: Approve payroll for {period}?
approve.description: Total net {total} for {count} people. Employees will see their payslips.

markPaid.title: Mark {period} as paid?
markPaid.description: Use this after the money has been transferred. It can't be undone.

workflow.PAID: Paid: employees can view and download their payslips.

row.title: Pay for {name} · {period}
row.basicHint: For this period only. The employee's basic salary doesn't change.
row.noItems: No allowances, overtime or deductions yet.
row.label: Description
row.hoursHint: For overtime: enter hours and the amount is worked out from the policy, or enter the amount yourself.
row.needAmount: Enter an amount (or hours for overtime).
row.locked: This period was submitted or approved, so it can't be changed.

payslips.title: Payslips
payslips.caption: My payslips
payslips.emptyText: Payslips appear here once each month's payroll is approved.
payslips.private: Pay data is confidential. Only you and authorised staff can see it.
